description: Post-D2 forward arc for K.S. Bhullar — RAW Special Secretary, Dulat-composite institutional skeptic. His arc is about institutional restraint vs. kinetic-doctrine alignment, not field operations.

actions.label: Counsel restraint — block kinetic doctrine
actions.description: Use institutional weight to slow Sanyal's Naya Bharat kinetic push. Lower attribution risk, lower mission yield.

actions.label: Endorse kinetic doctrine
actions.description: Switch position — support Naya Bharat kinetic operations. Higher mission yield, higher attribution risk.

actions.label: Open Track-II back channel with Pakistan
actions.description: Use Dulat-style back-channel network to de-escalate. Trades short-term mission yield for long-term durability.

actions.label: Publish (semi-public) doctrine critique
actions.description: Use memoir / op-ed channel to push institutional view. Some attribution exposure but builds long-term credibility.

actions.label: Advise calibrated post-Pahalgam response
actions.description: Push for measured kinetic-plus-diplomatic response rather than maximalist Sindoor.

actions.label: Retire to elder-statesman advisory role
actions.description: Step back from operational influence to long-term advisory/strategic role.

events.label: Post-D2 doctrinal review
events.description: RAW-IB friction recurs as Sanyal pushes Naya Bharat further. Bhullar's institutional position needed.

events.label: ISI pressure peaks
events.description: ISI's CI sweep pushes back-channel actors. Time-window for Track-II vs hardening.

events.label: Pahalgam attack
events.description: Hard pressure on every restraint argument.

events.label: Sindoor planning window
events.description: Last chance to influence the doctrine commit.
